words.definition: a person or company that creates software or property developments
words.example: The developer plans to build a new office tower downtown.
words.exampleTranslation: 這家開發商計劃在市中心興建一棟新的辦公大樓。
words.note: 動詞形：develop (v.) 開發，例如 The company plans to develop this land into a shopping mall。

words.definition: the main office of an organization (usually plural: headquarters)
words.example: The regional office reports directly to the company headquarters.
words.exampleTranslation: 區域辦公室直接向公司總部回報。
words.note: 通常用複數形 headquarters，例如 The company's headquarters is located in Taipei。

words.definition: a vehicle that travels regularly back and forth over a short route
words.example: A free shuttle runs between the hotel and the convention center.
words.exampleTranslation: 飯店和會議中心之間有免費接駁車往返。
words.note: 動詞形：shuttle (v.) 穿梭往返，例如 Buses shuttle passengers between the airport terminals。

words.definition: writing materials such as paper, pens, and envelopes
words.example: Order more stationery before the office supply runs out.
words.exampleTranslation: 在文具用完之前請再訂購一些。
words.note: 易與 stationary（靜止的）混淆，兩字發音相同但意思不同

words.definition: to arrange to receive a publication or service regularly
words.example: Subscribe to the newsletter to receive weekly market updates.
words.exampleTranslation: 訂閱電子報以獲得每週市場動態。
words.note: 常用片語 subscribe to（訂閱⋯）

words.definition: in a similar way; resembling one another
words.example: The two proposals look alike but differ in cost.
words.exampleTranslation: 這兩份提案看起來很相似，但成本不同。
words.note: alike 通常放在名詞或動詞之後作表語，不放在名詞前面修飾

words.definition: the distinctive taste of a food or drink
words.example: The café added a new seasonal coffee flavor this month.
words.exampleTranslation: 這家咖啡廳這個月新增了一款季節限定口味。
words.note: 美式拼法為 flavor，英式拼法為 flavour

words.definition: an outdoor meal eaten as a casual social event
words.example: The team is planning a picnic to celebrate the project's completion.
words.exampleTranslation: 團隊正在計劃一場野餐來慶祝專案完成。
words.note: 動詞形：picnic (v.) 去野餐，現在分詞需重複字尾子音寫成 picnicking

words.definition: a set of instructions for preparing a dish
words.example: The chef shared his recipe for the restaurant's signature dish.
words.exampleTranslation: 主廚分享了餐廳招牌菜的食譜。
words.note: 常見比喻用法 a recipe for disaster（招致失敗的做法）

words.definition: food or drink provided at an event, especially light snacks
words.example: Refreshments will be served during the afternoon break.
words.exampleTranslation: 下午的休息時間會提供茶點。
words.note: 通常用複數形 refreshments 表示茶點

words.definition: relating to the management and organization of a business or office
words.example: She handles all the administrative tasks for the department.
words.exampleTranslation: 她負責處理部門所有的行政事務。
words.note: 相關詞：administration (n.) 行政；管理部門，例如 the company's administration building。

words.definition: to give official permission for something
words.example: Only the finance director can authorize expenses over a certain amount.
words.exampleTranslation: 只有財務主管能批准超過一定金額的支出。
words.note: 相關詞：authorization (n.) 授權；批准，例如 You need written authorization to access this file。

words.definition: in a way that happens often or is usually the case
words.example: This software is commonly used by small businesses.
words.exampleTranslation: 這款軟體通常被小型企業使用。
words.note: 常用片語 commonly known as（俗稱為）

words.definition: the process of supplying goods to stores or customers
words.example: The company improved its distribution network to reach rural areas.
words.exampleTranslation: 這家公司改善了配送網絡以觸及鄉村地區。
words.note: 動詞形：distribute (v.) 分配；配送，例如 The company distributes its products worldwide。

words.definition: a long upholstered seat for more than one person
words.example: A new sofa was added to the office waiting area.
words.exampleTranslation: 辦公室的等候區新增了一張沙發。
words.note: 美式英語中常用同義詞 couch 表示沙發

words.definition: to provide space or lodging for someone, or to adapt to their needs
words.example: The venue can accommodate up to two hundred guests.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個場地最多可以容納兩百位賓客。
words.note: 相關詞：accommodation (n.) 住宿；容納空間，例如 The hotel offers accommodation for large groups。

words.definition: priced at a level that people can reasonably pay
words.example: The company offers affordable health plans for all employees.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司為所有員工提供負擔得起的健康保險方案。
words.note: 動詞形：afford (v.) 負擔得起，例如 We can't afford to lose this client。

words.definition: to make someone slightly angry or irritated
words.example: Repeated system errors began to annoy the customer support team.
words.exampleTranslation: 反覆出現的系統錯誤開始讓客服團隊感到惱怒。
words.note: 相關詞：annoyed (adj.) 感到惱怒的，例如 She felt annoyed by the constant interruptions。

words.definition: to travel regularly between home and work
words.example: Many employees commute by train from the suburbs.
words.exampleTranslation: 許多員工從郊區搭火車通勤。
words.note: 相關詞：commuter (n.) 通勤者，例如 The train was packed with commuters during rush hour。

words.definition: routine written or clerical work, such as forms and documents
words.example: New hires need to complete some paperwork on their first day.
words.exampleTranslation: 新進員工在第一天需要完成一些文書工作。
words.note: 不可數名詞，沒有複數形，不可說 paperworks
